title: Blog export
description: Output of scripts/export-blogs.mjs: the entire BlogTable reassembled into clean, import-ready blog objects. There is no publish date in the source table; publishDate is not present. See analytics.history[].date for weekly analytics run dates (Mondays), which are a rough lower-bound proxy for when a post existed.

exportedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the export ran.

region.description: AWS region, or null if resolved from the ambient config.

itemsScanned.description: Total raw table items read during the scan.

blogs.description: One object per catalog entry (canonical article), sorted by url.

tenant.description: Owner of a blog plus its publishing config. Only pk/sk are guaranteed; the rest depend on how the tenant was provisioned.

apiKeyParameter.description: SSM SecureString path holding the tenant's secrets JSON.

slug.description: Article slug (url with the leading '/blog/' stripped). Omitted only if the catalog pk was not a string.

url.description: Canonical site-relative URL and the catalog partition key, e.g. '/blog/my-post'.

canonicalUrl.description: Absolute canonical URL (https://readysetcloud.io/blog/<slug>), or null when no slug could be derived.

tenantId.description: Derived from the catalog GSI1PK ('blog#<tenantId>'). Null if GSI1PK was missing/malformed.

fileName.description: Source markdown path, from the catalog GSI1SK, e.g. 'posts/my-post.md'.

links.description: Native URLs of each cross-posted copy plus the canonical 'url'. Null if the catalog entry had no links map. Absent per-platform keys mean that copy was never published/recorded.

ids.description: Per-platform post id of each copy (used by the analytics job). Null if absent.

publish.description: Publish state from the idempotency record (pk='<tenantId>#<fileName>'). Null when no idempotency record joined to this catalog entry.

latest.description: Most recent weekly snapshot, or null if none.

history.description: All weekly snapshots for this article, sorted ascending by date.

publisherResult.description: Per-platform publish outcome from the idempotency record. Null if that platform has no entry. May contain only 'status' when in progress or failed.

snapshot.description: One weekly analytics snapshot. 'date' is the analytics run date (a Monday), NOT the article's publish date.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from the snapshot sort key 'viewCount-<date>'.

weekly.description: Week-over-week deltas per source. Null if absent on the item.

allTime.description: Running totals per source at snapshot time. Null if absent on the item.

viewCounts.description: View counts keyed by source. Values are numbers.
